name: How do I choose an AEO provider for my accounting practice?
description: Choose an AEO provider with proven expertise in AI optimization and the accounting industry, transparent processes, and customized strategies.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose an AEO provider for my accounting practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an AEO provider, look for a firm with demonstrated expertise in both AI optimization and the accounting industry. Evaluate their understanding of current AI algorithms and their ability to translate complex financial concepts into AI-friendly content. Request case studies or examples of their work. A good provider will offer a transparent process, clear reporting on progress, and a customized strategy tailored to your specific firm's goals and target audience, rather than a generic approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO provider with proven expertise in AI optimization and the accounting industry, transparent processes, and customized strategies.
